text:
marta: SOS — my RB just rolled an ankle during warmups, waiver claim pending but might not clear before lineup lock. anyone willing to swap a starter for week 16? i can offer bench depth + homemade empanadas (office pickup friday).

jamal: which RBs are you targeting? i can help but need someone who catches passes. empanadas?? count me in :raised_hands:

sophia: i'm remote this week but can do a 1-for-1 depending who you're dropping. who are you thinking?

kevin: if the waiver doesn't go through, you could ask the commish for an emergency sub. trenchard is on waivers rn — low roster % though. http://fantasy.league/waivers/123

marta: targeting Isaiah Cobb (10% rostered) or D. Trenchard. debating dropping J. Williams or K. Moore. empanadas for everyone in kitchen friday if i land Cobb :taco:

jamal: i'll swap Cobb for Williams. ping me here once commish okays and i'll make the move. i'll bring hot sauce :hot_pepper:

sophia: @alex can you approve the trade/emergency add? i'm fine with the swap and want empanadas recorded as collateral :joy:

alex: approved — commish here. make it official in the app, jamal. good luck with the ankle.

marta: done. waiver processed. thanks y'all. empanadas on me Friday 12:30 in the kitchen. anyone want salsa too? quick poll: salsa or guac?

jamal: salsa. 

sophia: guac pls 

kevin: salsa + ketchup for the weirdos

marta: noted. salsa wins by sweet politics :grinning_face_with_big_eyes: see you friday!
